\-MS Teams is the best method for collaboration.
\-The digital magazine must launch one week before November 1st, which means October 25th.

Please confirm whether everything is clear.

Thanks,

Lena Mercer

candidates.text:
Hi A,

I've started looking through what you sent—thank you.

Could you explain what you mean by the "many typos and punctuation errors/inconsistencies"? The articles were double checked with Ai, so please give me more detail.

Here is my general feedback:

1\. Many articles finish with an 'empty white' area. We cannot show those spaces, though I am unsure whether the answer is adding images, changing the font, using an icon image, or including more Ads. As a standard, every article should end like the 'Confirmed Alien Existence Can’t Cast Doubt on Christianity' article, for example.

2\. There is some blurriness in the Ads. I cannot tell whether that comes from their originally being PSD files, the PDF view, or something else.

3\. Fonts - Although I like the italic font used along the sides, the main font feels too light or frail. It may be the style rather than the font itself. For the best appearance and spacing, I recommend Garamond; I am attaching it along with two others.

4\. Correct page numbers for the articles featured there must appear on the cover image. This might or might not depend on uploading the final PDF to the magazine FLIP BOOK at <https://heyzine.com/>. Please create a free account and test the layout so you can confirm that it remains balanced and works with the 2-page spreads.

5\. Because the layout was not yet complete, the TABLE OF CONTENTS page is currently inaccurate. Send me the correct page numbers for the update so that you can place it afterward.

Once these items are sorted out, the publication is looking good and is probably 1 day away from launch. If you need a couple more Ads or anything similar, just tell me.

Many thanks, and have a good rest!

LM

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hi A,

First, the work is good, so please rest easy about that. The only problem has been the tight deadline, which is often unavoidable with magazines because of their nature. Since the template has been created, the hardest part is complete.

Realistically, we have 1 hour left for fixes, and these are the outstanding points:

- Some pages have large areas of empty white space. We need to add at least 1-2 images related to that particular article's subject matter to fill those areas.

- The flip book is displaying heyzine.com branding. Is there no other way, such as a white label?

Thanks.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
I understand, and I am VERY humble and nice. Still, I can't allow that to cause a project to fail.

Whether a project is completed as agreed has nothing to do with its price or perceived value. This is a November issue, so it cannot launch later. Once you accept a project, you must ensure you have enough time to finish it, using as little or as much effort as necessary; otherwise, the whole thing becomes a waste for everyone.

The remark wasn't callous either. If a freelancer says the stated scope is inaccurate, that has to be confirmed. The print portion really was included in the original scope, and I removed it specifically to reduce the pressure.

I'm pleased with the work. The deadline is the only difficult part for both you and me—that's it, and I'm not complaining about anything else.

Here are the images, which should be inserted only on pages with the huge empty spaces:
